correctness.rationale: Exact real Banach-space numerical-radius reduction to ten primal vertices and dual edge supports, checked incidence row, dihedral reductions, a two-branch minimax for the only nontrivial dual edge, and equality exclusion on all remaining edges prove the sharp golden-ratio bound and exactly ten signed rank-one extremizers. The critical identity \((1-r^2s)(r+r^2s)=r+r^4s(1-s)\) follows from \(r^2=1-r\). The witness \(v_0\otimes q_2\) is norm one, has numerical radius \(r\), and squares to zero. SymPy checker passed 895 exact/finite consistency assertions; finite tests do not substitute for the complete inequalities.

value.rationale: Computes a natural full rank-one numerical-index invariant not inferred from the ordinary index (their ratio is exactly 2), and classifies all attaining rank-one operators as square-zero. It completes the specific decagon benchmark in a sequence of studied polyhedral-plane families; full equality classification is mathematically structural rather than a routine check. Not claimed to determine rank-one indices for all polygon sizes.
